title: Overview
description: I am a senior software engineer and tech lead with 18 years of experience in enterprise software, 8 of them leading engineering teams. I started in QA in 2008 and grew through full stack development into team lead, head of software development and head of IT platform product development roles, working for finance, banking and industrial clients such as Intesa Sanpaolo, Sisal, SIA and Cerved. I get productive quickly on existing codebases, deliver robust backends and frontends, from Java, Kotlin and Node.js services to Angular frontends and Android apps, and bring architecture and delivery experience to the team. Since 2025 I have been working as a freelancer under the HeroHubs brand, consulting enterprise clients on cloud-native backends on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, with AI as part of my daily workflow.
